description_for_human: Search Vietnam real estate listings — apartments, houses, villas, land plots, commercial properties for sale or rent across Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Da Nang and other Vietnamese cities.
description_for_model: Plugin for searching and reading real estate listings in Vietnam from BinHorizon, the country's leading marketplace. Supports filtering by transaction type (for sale / for rent), property category (apartment, house, villa, land, office, retail, warehouse, hotel), city, and Vietnamese full-text search (unaccented input also works). Returns prices in VND (1 tỷ = 1 billion VND ≈ $40,000 USD), areas in m², and full address with GPS coordinates. Use /api/listings for search and /api/listings/{id}.md for clean Markdown view of a single listing. /api/news returns market news, /api/stats gives aggregate price statistics. All endpoints are free, no auth required.
